# @three-ws/glb-diff

> Structural diff for glTF/GLB. Tells you what actually changed between two 3D models: geometry, materials, textures, skeletons, animations, with git-style rename and move detection. Isomorphic library plus a CI-ready CLI.

@three-ws/glb-diff is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/glb-diff`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/glb-diff/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/glb-diff/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/glb-diff/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/glb-diff/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
